question.text: For the annual PPM compliance audit, SEBI has made the audit of certain PPM sections OPTIONAL. Which of the following is NOT among the sections whose audit is optional?

answer.text: Distribution Waterfall and Class of Units Review

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.2, audit of the following PPM sections is OPTIONAL: Risk Factors, Legal/Regulatory/Tax Considerations, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees and Expenses, and Glossary and Terms. Distribution Waterfall and Class of Units is a separate PPM section and is not in this optional carve-out, so its audit is not optional. The Trap: All four options sound like routine disclosure sections, but only Distribution Waterfall and Class of Units falls outside the optional list — the other three are explicitly named as optional. Note: The annual PPM compliance audit itself is mandatory; SEBI's carve-out only makes the audit of certain named PPM sections optional, not the audit as a whole.
